sources.label: Merak Patches: small patches that make Android apps nicer to use, for Morphe. Go
sources.author: Merak
patch_list: Adds categories to organize accounts, shown as folders or as cards. Switch layouts and manage categories from the bar above the account list.
Changes the app name and launcher icon, so the patched app is easy to tell apart from the original Google Authenticator.

Allows signing in with a Google Account and using Google Account sync by using GmsCore (MicroG-RE) instead of Google Play services. The app is installed under a different package name, so it can be installed next to the original app.
